rationale: The plan correctly recognizes log2(TPM+1) values are not counts, refuses DESeq2/edgeR, and forbids re-normalization or a second log, but it omits the value-range sanity check and never specifies trend=TRUE for limma-trend on non-voom log values. QC is limited to a PCA/MDS and p-value histogram with no distance heatmap and no stated outlier policy, and there is no low-expression filter at all (all 12000 genes are tested). The design is ~condition with no reference level or explicit contrast named, and the |logFC|>1 cutoff is applied post hoc rather than via treat. Enrichment is not warranted by the task; it is added with a named, versioned collection but no explicit universe or size window and a logFC-only ranking, and the report lacks package versions.
